certification.name: Certified Protection Professional
certification.description: Security management certification covering seven domains of security practice. The exam has 225 multiple-choice questions (200 scored) in four hours and requires five to seven years of security experience depending on degree; recertification needs 60 CPE credits every three years.
certification.currency_note: Non-member fee; ASIS members $580. Fees from the ASIS Board Certification Handbook
